description: Re-run chain discovery and rewrite the chain registry file. Call this after starting a new daemon, stopping a daemon, or when the registry appears stale. Discovery scans OS-appropriate data directories for .conf files, parses them, and calls getinfo on each discovered chain to confirm it's running. PBaaS chains with hex-encoded folder names are resolved to friendly names via the VRSC daemon. The updated registry is written atomically. Available in read-only mode.
name: refresh_chains
